# Coverage — what this spec does and does not cover

The NGP VAN API is much larger than this spec. Before concluding that
something is impossible, check which of the three sections below it
falls into. **Never invent an endpoint that is not listed here.**

## 1. In the spec, verified against the live API

These have pages under `operations/`. Behavior in them has been probed.

| Endpoint group | Paths | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Echoes | `POST /echoes` | **validated** |
| People — find | `POST /people/find` | **validated** (incl. minimum match combinations) |
| Survey Questions — list | `GET /surveyQuestions` | **validated** |
| People — get by id | `GET /people/{vanId}` | **validated** (incl. stateful links from `/people/find`, and what `isBest`/`isPreferred` mean on each contact method) |
| People — write | `POST /people/create`, `POST /people/findOrCreate`, `POST /people/{vanId}` (update) | **validated** (incl. the full writeable scalar field set: the six fields gated behind `$expand=preferences`, the three accepted-and-discarded, and the two that need `contactMode: Organization`) |
| People — search | `GET /people` (requires ≥1 search param; `GET /people/quickSearch` does **not** exist — 404 "No HTTP resource") | **validated** (incl. what each address/contact filter actually reads: `streetAddress`/`city`/`stateOrProvince`/`zipOrPostalCode` the Voting address only, `phoneNumber` the single best phone, `email` every address) |
| People — merge | `PUT /people/{vanId}/mergeInto` | **validated** (sandbox key is permitted; `whatIf` parsing trap, contact-method dedup and preferred-email recomputation confirmed live) |
| People — notes | `GET/POST /people/{vanId}/notes`, `GET/PUT/DELETE /people/{vanId}/notes/{noteId}` | **validated** (list + create; `PUT` spec'd from docs only and `GET`/`DELETE` by id left out — all three are `403 FORBIDDEN` "Access to this action is restricted" for the sandbox key) |
| Note Categories | `GET /notes/categories`, `GET /notes/categories/{noteCategoryId}`, `GET /notes/categoryTypes` | **validated** (bare arrays, no envelope; sandbox committee has none opted in, so only the empty array and 404s observed — item shape and the `assignableTypes` vocabulary from docs; `categoryTypes` is `403 FORBIDDEN` for the sandbox key) |

## 2. Real endpoints, researched but deliberately not in the spec

These exist. The spec omits them for the reason given — usually that the
sandbox key cannot reach them, so the success shape was never observed.
You can still call them; you just have no schema for the response.

| Endpoint group | Paths | Why not spec'd |
| --- | --- | --- |
| People — delete | `DELETE /people/{vanId}` | researched (route exists; sandbox key gets `403 FORBIDDEN` "Access to this action is restricted", so success shape unknown — deliberately left out of the spec) |
| Survey Questions — CRUD | `POST /surveyQuestions`, `GET/PUT /surveyQuestions/{id}` | researched (create 400s captured; valid `type` values unknown) |
| API Key Profiles | `GET /apiKeyProfiles` | researched (probed; returns items envelope with rate-limit profile) |
| Canvass Responses (lookups) | `GET /canvassResponses/{contactTypes,inputTypes,resultCodes}` | researched (probed contactTypes: bare array, no envelope) |

## 3. Known to exist, not yet researched

Paths gathered from the official docs and the NGPVAN/van-cli source but
never probed. **If a request needs one of these, say so rather than
improvising with the endpoints in section 1.** Bulk questions — totals
across a whole database, exports, anything that would otherwise need
thousands of paged requests — almost always land here, under Export Jobs,
Saved Lists or Changed Entity Export Jobs.

| Endpoint group | Paths |
| --- | --- |
| People — sub-resources | `/people/{vanId}/{activistCodes,canvassResponses,customFields,scores,stories}` |
| Activist Codes | `GET /activistCodes`, `GET /activistCodes/{id}` |
| Bulk Import | `GET/POST /bulkImportJobs`, `/{jobId}/{cancel,errors,results,start,upload}` |
| Changed Entity Export Jobs | `POST /changedEntityExportJobs`, `/{jobId}`, `/{jobId}/{cancel,downloadUrl,status}` |
| Codes | `GET /codes/{contactTypes,inputTypes,resultCodes,supporterGroups}` + by-id |
| Contributions | `GET/POST /contributions`, `/{id}`, `/recentContributions`, `/payments` |
| Custom Fields | `GET /customFields`, `/{id}` |
| Departments | `GET /departments`, `/{id}` |
| Designations | `GET /designations`, `/{id}` |
| Disbursements | `GET /disbursements/recentDisbursements` |
| Early Vote Fields | `GET /earlyVoteFields`, `/{id}` |
| Email | `GET /email/messages`, `/email/message/{foreignMessageId}` |
| Employers / Labor | `/employers/{id}/bargainingUnits/…`, `/jobClasses/{id}`, `/worksites/{id}/…` |
| Events | `GET/POST /events`, `/{eventId}`, `/events/types`, `/types/{id}` |
| Export Jobs | `GET/POST /exportJobs`, `/{id}`, `/{id}/downloadUrl` |
| File Loading Jobs | `POST /fileLoadingJobs` |
| Folders / Map Regions | `/folders/{folderId}/mapRegions`, `/{mapRegionId}`, `…/refresh` |
| Locations | `GET/POST /locations`, `/{id}`, `/findOrCreate` |
| MiniVAN Exports | `GET /minivanExports` |
| Printed Lists | `GET /printedLists` |

| Stories | `GET/POST /stories`, `/{id}` |

| Introspection | (see docs "Introspection" page) |

## Confirmed absent

- `GET /people/quickSearch` — 404 "No HTTP resource". It does not exist,
  in any casing. Use `GET /people` (searchPeople).
- There is no count-by-attribute or aggregate endpoint of any kind. The
  only total the API volunteers is `count` in the pagination envelope,
  which counts matches for a query you already had to specify.
